verdict.rationale: Ironclad exposes a full REST/OAuth API (including machine-to-machine Client Credentials Grant) that lets workflows, records, and documents be created, launched, and bulk-launched without any UI, plus webhooks for event-driven automation — this is functionally 'headless' automation suitable for CI/scripted pipelines. However, there is no explicit CLI, no CI/CD (e.g. GitHub Actions) integration guide, and no independent evidence of it being run inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or CI/CD integration docs, independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage, explicit 'headless mode' framing.
